R_RARITY_SLOTS.rule: Normal: 0 explicit; Magic: max 1 prefix + 1 suffix; Rare: max 3 prefix + 3 suffix

R_ILVL_GATE.rule: A mod tier can roll only if mod.lvl <= item level

R_MOD_GROUP.rule: Only one mod per modifier group on an item; guaranteed-mod currency fails instead of duplicating

R_ONE_CRAFTED.rule: 0.5+: max 1 crafted modifier per item (Essence, Perfect/special Essence, Runic Alloy, liquid emotion, some Runic Ward enchants share this slot); the rune Astrid's Creativity socketed allows 1 more

R_ONE_DESECRATED.rule: 0.5+: max 1 Desecrated modifier per item (items with Desecrated modifiers cannot be Desecrated again); Desecrated mods do NOT count as crafted

R_DESECRATE_FULL.rule: Desecrating adds an Unrevealed Desecrated modifier; if the modifiers are full, a random modifier is also removed

R_DESECRATE_REVEAL.rule: The Unrevealed Desecrated modifier already has its side (prefix or suffix: the Necromancy omen's, else at random). The Well of Souls offers 3 modifiers of that side: 1, 2 or 3 desecrated-only ones (80% / 15% / 5%) and base modifiers that could roll there for …

R_FLUX.rule: A Flux turns every resistance modifier of the other elements into the same tier of its element and rolls the value again; an item that already has that resistance keeps both (two modifiers of one group)

R_FRACTURED_LOCK.rule: A Fractured modifier is locked permanently: it cannot be removed or altered (a Divine Orb leaves its values; a Fracturing Orb cannot be used on Fractured items)

R_MIN_MOD_LEVEL.rule: Currency with a Minimum Modifier Level adds random modifiers of at least that level, except a modifier type that would be excluded entirely (it keeps its best tier); it cannot be used on items with an item level below that level

R_MAX_ITEM_LEVEL.rule: Currency with a Maximum Item Level (Gnawed bones: 64) cannot be used on items above that level

R_CORRUPTED_LOCK.rule: Corrupted items cannot be modified except by currencies that explicitly target corrupted items (Architect's Orb, Orbs of Sacrifice, Vaal Cultivation Orb, ...)

R_SANCTIFIED_LOCK.rule: Sanctifying multiplies each modifier value by a random 78% to 122%; most methods of crafting and modification cannot be used on Sanctified items

R_VALUE_MULT_05.rule: 0.5+: Sanctify and the Vaal value-randomise outcome multiply each mod value from its CURRENT value (Divine to max first)

R_JEWEL_SLOTS.rule: Rare jewels: 2 prefix + 2 suffix by default (Magic jewels 1 + 1). The liquid emotion modifiers "+1 Prefix Modifier allowed" and "+1 Suffix Modifier allowed" raise one side by 1 (game data: +1 on that side, +0 on the other). With the allowance mod a jewel hold…

R_NO_SPACE.rule: A currency that removes a modifier and adds one (Chaos Orb, liquid emotion, Perfect essence) needs a slot for the new modifier once the old one is gone; otherwise the game refuses it ("Item has no space for more modifiers") and nothing is spent. On an item ov…

R_SWAP_REMOVAL.rule: Perfect and Corrupted essences and liquid emotions remove a random modifier and add a guaranteed one: when the side of the new modifier is full, the removed modifier is one of that side; otherwise any modifier can go (Omens of Sinistral/Dextral Crystallisatio…

R_RUNE_POOLS.rule: Six socket-bound runes give the item a tag, and the modifiers with a spawn weight on that tag can then roll like the item's own prefixes and suffixes: Kolr's Hunt (Marksman, gloves), Katla's Gloom (Decay, gloves), Vorana's Carnage (Berserking, helmets), Uhtre…

R_EXCEPTIONAL.rule: An exceptional base can drop, even as a Normal item, with one augment socket more than its class usually has, with quality above 20%, or with both. Artificer's Orb adds sockets only up to the usual number (2 on body armour and two-handed weapons, else 1): on …

R_WEIGHTS.rule: Real roll weights are not in client data (spawn weight 0/1). Weights come from poe2db; Craft of Exile gives the same chances for 8,929 of its 8,987 tiers (jewels as a fixed multiple) and differs on 58 (weapon skill level tiers, cast speed on jewellery, a few …

transmute.rule: Orb of Transmutation, Greater Orb of Transmutation, Perfect Orb of Transmutation: -> Magic with 1 random mod. Floors: Greater 44, Perfect 70 (game_data).

augment.rule: Orb of Augmentation, Greater Orb of Augmentation, Perfect Orb of Augmentation: +1 random mod. Floors: Greater 44, Perfect 70 (game_data).

regal.rule: Regal Orb, Greater Regal Orb, Perfect Regal Orb: -> Rare, +1 random mod. Floors: Greater 35, Perfect 50 (game_data).

alchemy.rule: Orb of Alchemy: -> Rare with 4 random mods.

exalt.rule: Exalted Orb, Greater Exalted Orb, Perfect Exalted Orb: +1 random mod. Floors: Greater 35, Perfect 50 (game_data).

chaos.rule: Chaos Orb, Greater Chaos Orb, Perfect Chaos Orb: remove 1 random mod + add 1 random mod (NOT a full reroll like PoE1). Floors: Greater 35, Perfect 50 (game_data).

annul.rule: Orb of Annulment: remove 1 random mod.

divine.rule: Divine Orb: randomise numeric values of mods.

chance.rule: Orb of Chance: -> random Unique of same class OR destroyed.

hinekora.rule: Hinekora's Lock: foresee result of next currency; any modification removes the foresight.

mirror.rule: Mirror of Kalandra: create mirrored copy.

essence_upgrade.rule: Lesser/normal/Greater Essence of X: -> Rare + guaranteed mod (counts as the 1 crafted mod).

essence_replace.rule: Perfect Essence of X + special essences (Abyss, Breach, Horror, Insanity, Delirium, Hysteria): remove 1 random mod + add guaranteed mod.

alloy.rule: 13 Runic Alloys: remove 1 random mod + add alloy-exclusive guaranteed mod (counts as crafted).

desecrate.rule: Bones: Jawbone (Rare weapon/quiver), Rib (Rare armour), Collarbone (Rare amulet/ring/belt), Altered Collarbone (+chance of otherworldly mods), Cranium (Rare jewel), Vertebrae (Rare waystone): adds 1 unrevealed Desecrated mod (its side is set now); reveal at W…

catalyst.rule: Catalysts (Flesh=Life, Neural=Mana, Carapace=Armour/Evasion/ES, Uul-Netol's=Physical, Xoph's=Fire, Tul's=Cold, Esh's=Lightning, Chayula's=Chaos, Reaver=Attack, Sibilant=Caster, Skittering=Speed, Adaptive=Attribute, Necrotic=Minion); Refined = same for jewels:…

quality.rule: Blacksmith's Whetstone (martial weapon), Armourer's Scrap (armour), Arcanist's Etcher (wand/staff/sceptre), Glassblower's Bauble (flask): +quality.

infuser.rule: Vaal Arcanist's/Armourer's/Blacksmith's/Catalysing Infuser: quality above max by up to 10%, chance to Corrupt.

flux.rule: Blazing/Chilling/Crackling/Void Flux: convert all elemental resistance mods to Fire/Cold/Lightning (Void: to Chaos) equivalents, same tier, value rolled again; the item can end with two of one element (R_FLUX).

sacrifice.rule: Kamasa's (amulet/ring/belt), Kopec's (armour), Yaomac's (weapon/quiver), Yugul's (jewel) Orb of Sacrifice: upgrade corruption enchantment + remove 1 random mod.

architect.rule: Architect's Orb: modify unpredictably or destroy.

cultivation.rule: Vaal Cultivation Orb: replace up to 2 mods / turn into corrupted Unique of same class.

verisium.rule: Verisium, Exceptional Verisium: Runeforging: adds Runic Ward; bases from level 55 give up part of their Armour/Evasion/Energy Shield for it (ArmourTypes); Uniques move to their Runeforged/Runemastered base and stay the same unique.

aldur_rune.rule: Passion of Aldur, Breath of Aldur, Ire of Aldur, Betrayal of Aldur: while socketed, transforms the other elements' modifiers into equivalent Fire (Passion), Cold (Breath), Lightning (Ire) or Chaos (Betrayal) modifiers; fractured modifiers stay.

liquid_emotion.rule: Liquid emotions (Diluted, plain, Concentrated and Potent; the Ancient ones are for Time-Lost jewels): removes a random modifier and adds the guaranteed crafted modifier the game lists for that jewel (liquid_emotions).

Omen of Homogenising Exaltation / Corona.rule: drops disabled since 0.4 (Standard legacy); not in 0.5.5

Omen of Sinistral Alchemy / Dextral Alch.rule: in the game files but not in the game: only the Orb of Alchemy exists

Omen of Sinistral Coronation / Dextral C.rule: in the game files but not in the game: a Regal Orb cannot be aimed at a side

Omen of Greater Annulment.rule: in the game files but not in the game: only the Orb of Annulment and the Sinistral and Dextral Annulment omens exist

Recombinator (Expedition).rule: removed with 0.5.0 (with the Omen of Recombination) and not back in 0.5.5

t2.rule: Greater and Perfect Regal, Chaos and Exalted Orbs: are the minimum modifier levels 35 and 50? (Greater Exalted, Chaos and Regal Orbs: 35; Perfect: 50. Such currency cannot be used below that item level either.)

t3.rule: A second crafted modifier is blocked (not overwritten)? (A second essence does not go on: the item keeps its one crafted modifier (an in-game report quoted "this item already has a crafted modifier").)

t4.rule: Gnawed bones only work on item level 64 or lower? (Gnawed bones show "Maximum Item Level: 64".)

t5.rule: Omen of Putrefaction in 0.5.5: all mods desecrated, item corrupted? (Your corrupted Tasalian Focus (Vortex Barrier) has six Desecrated mods (September 2026).)

t6.rule: Can Runic Alloys be found or used in Forbidden Rites? (Runic Alloys trade in Forbidden Rites (e.g. Mystic Alloy about 7,300 a day, Runebinder's Alloy about 1,400, 27 Sept 2026).)

t7.rule: Sanctify multiplier range (78-122%?) (Each modifier value is multiplied by a random 78% to 122%; most crafting cannot be used afterwards.)

t9.rule: Omen of Whittling removes the lowest level mod (not the lowest tier)? (It removes the lowest level modifier, not the lowest tier.)

t10.rule: A bone on a full item removes a random mod first? (If the modifiers are full, a random modifier is also removed.)

t11.rule: Lich mods need item level 65+ and a Preserved or Ancient bone? (Kurgal, Amanamu and Ulaman modifiers are level 65, and Gnawed bones stop at item level 64: lich modifiers need item level 65+ and a Preserved or Ancient bone.)

t12.rule: Omen of Catalysing Exaltation works together with a side exaltation omen? (Yes: Omen of Catalysing Exaltation can be combined with Omen of Sinistral or Dextral Exaltation.)

t13.rule: Direction of lowest_ratio and highest_ratio in the Currency Exchange data (Both fields hold paired amounts {A: x, B: y}; the price of A in B is y/x. lowest/highest are that hour's price range (checked on the 25 September data).)

t14.rule: Does the Alt+Ctrl+C copy include mod tags? (Yes: the Alt+Ctrl+C headers carry the modifier tags after a dash, e.g. { Prefix Modifier "Prismatic" (Tier: 1) — Damage, Elemental, Fire, Cold, Lightning }; modifiers without tags show none. The parser reads them.)

t15.rule: Do sword, axe, dagger or flail bases drop in 0.5.5? (Not obtainable in 0.5.x; they are expected with 1.0.)

t16.rule: Can Astrid's Creativity be obtained in Forbidden Rites? (Astrid's Creativity trades in Forbidden Rites (about 9,800 a day, 27 Sept 2026).)

t17.rule: Does a Divine Orb reroll the values of fractured modifiers? (A Fractured modifier cannot be removed or altered; the planner leaves its values alone.)

t18.rule: Do essences check item level (for example a level 72 essence modifier on an item level 64 item)? (No: an essence adds its modifier whatever the item level (a level 72 essence modifier can go on an item level 64 item). The planner already works that way.)

t19.rule: Can a Fracturing Orb be used on an item that already has a fractured modifier? (Fracturing Orbs cannot be used on Fractured items.)

t20.rule: What does a Flux do when the item already has a resistance of the target element (for example Blazing Flux on an item with Fire and Cold Resistance)? (Every resistance modifier of the other elements turns into the same tier of the target element with its valu…

t21.rule: Can Orbs of Transmutation, Regal Orbs or Orbs of Alchemy be used on jewels? (Yes: jewels are crafted like other gear (Transmutation, Augmentation, Regal, then Exalted Orbs). The game-data flag was a guess and is not used.)

t29.rule: Which catalysts can be applied to a Grasping Mail ("Catalysts can be applied to this item")? (Grasping Mail takes every catalyst that works on rings and amulets and rolls like a ring.)

t34.rule: Does an Omen of Sinistral or Dextral Crystallisation aim a Runic Alloy, or only Perfect and Corrupted Essences as its text says? (An alloy is not used with a Crystallisation omen: the omen aims Perfect and Corrupted Essences only, as its text says.)

k7.rule: Chaos Shards combine into a Chaos Orb

k9.rule: Omen of the Blackblooded, Liege and Sovereign guarantee a Kurgal, Amanamu or Ulaman modifier on weapon or jewellery desecration

k10.rule: An item can have only one crafted modifier and one desecrated modifier

k11.rule: Omen of Putrefaction creates an item with six desecrated modifiers

k13.rule: Exact percentage chances for crafting outcomes

k14.rule: Use Omen of Homogenising Exaltation for level crafts

k15.rule: Use the Recombinator to merge items

k18.rule: Vaal Orb can turn a Unique into a random Rare

k20.rule: Sanctify multiplies values by 78 to 122 percent

k21.rule: Greater Orb of Transmutation and Augmentation have minimum modifier level 44

k23.rule: Perfect Orb of Transmutation has minimum modifier level 70

k24.rule: Greater and Perfect Regal, Chaos and Exalted Orbs have floors 35 and 50

k25.rule: If a floor removes a whole mod family the best legal tier can still roll

k26.rule: Gnawed bones work on items of item level 64 or below

k28.rule: Ancient bones apply minimum modifier level 40

k29.rule: Omen of Light makes Orb of Annulment remove only the desecrated modifier

k31.rule: Sanctify and Vaal value changes multiply the current value

k32.rule: Omen of Corruption controls Vaal outcomes

k37.rule: Omen of Catalysing Exaltation consumes catalyst quality to raise the chance of the matching mod type

k38.rule: Necrotic Catalyst boosts minion modifiers on rings and amulets

k39.rule: Liquid emotions replace a random jewel modifier like a Greater Essence

k41.rule: Tier 1 in Advanced Mod Descriptions is the best tier

k42.rule: Omen of Sinistral Exaltation makes Exalted Orb add only a prefix

k43.rule: Omen of Dextral Erasure makes Chaos Orb remove only a suffix

k44.rule: Omen of Greater Exaltation makes Exalted Orb add two modifiers

k45.rule: Fractured modifiers cannot be removed or changed

k46.rule: Corrupted items only accept corrupted-item currency

k47.rule: The Well of Souls offers base modifiers as well as desecrated-only ones; a lich omen offers only that lich's

k48.rule: A Flux can leave two resistance modifiers of one element on an item

k49.rule: Jewels can be crafted with Transmutation, Augmentation, Regal and Exalted Orbs

k50.rule: Roll weights of natural modifiers (poe2db) match Craft of Exile

k51.rule: Desecrated-only modifiers all roll with the same weight

k52.rule: Essences do not check the item level

k53.rule: Omen of Catalysing Exaltation at 20% quality makes the matching modifier type very likely (about x25 its weight)

k54.rule: A jewel keeps three suffixes (or prefixes) after its "+1 Suffix (Prefix) Modifier allowed" modifier is removed, and the other side can still be filled: five modifiers

k55.rule: On a jewel with three suffixes over the limit and both prefixes filled, a Chaos Orb only changes prefixes and Potent Liquid Ferocity only gives "increased Effect of Suffixes"

k56.rule: Potent Liquid Contempt gives "+1 Suffix Modifier allowed" or "+1 Prefix Modifier allowed" with even chances whatever the item holds

k57.rule: A Fracturing Orb never picks a Desecrated modifier, but a hidden one counts for the four modifiers the orb needs (1 in 3 with three others)

k59.rule: Essence of the Abyss leaves the crafted modifier "Bears the Mark of the Abyssal Lord", and the next desecration replaces that Mark instead of taking a free slot or removing another modifier; the essence cannot be used on an item that has a Desecrated modifier

k62.rule: With Hinekora's Lock on an item, every currency item held over it shows its own result, the results of different currency items are drawn apart, and any currency that is used (a Divine Orb too) spends the lock

k63.rule: Omen of Putrefaction reveals its up to six Desecrated modifiers like any other, three options each, and a modifier taken at one reveal takes the Well's entries of its groups out of the next reveals of the item

A_FLUX_TIER.rule: Flux: an "equivalent" resistance modifier is the same tier number of the new element.

A_DESECRATE_SIDE.rule: Desecrating a full item: the removed modifier is from a side that can hold the desecrated one.

A_ESSENCE_EVEN.rule: An essence with several outcomes and no weights in the files gives each of them equally often.

A_ENCHANT_EVEN.rule: Corruption Enchantments: each one the base can take is equally likely.

A_SANCTIFY_EVEN.rule: Omen of Sanctification: each value is multiplied by 78% to 122%, every factor equally likely.

A_DES_WEIGHTS.rule: Desecrated-only modifiers at the Well of Souls are equally likely (Craft of Exile gives them weight 1).

A_WEIGHTS.rule: Roll chances come from poe2db weights (the client data has only 0/1); Craft of Exile agrees on 8,929 of 8,987 tiers.

A_CATALYST_RING.rule: A base that says "Catalysts can be applied" takes the ring and amulet catalysts, with the same rules as on rings and amulets.

A_RUNE_POOL_WELL.rule: The Well of Souls does not offer a socketed rune's pool: no plan counts on it.

A_RUNE_POOL_WEIGHT.rule: How often the Well of Souls offers a socketed rune's pool modifiers against the item's own. Not modelled: a route with a bone step on an item with a pool rune is not offered as a recommendation.

V1_FORGEMARK.rule: Crimson Iron / Scarlet Hide / Vermilion Gold: a Forgemark in place of a chosen modifier on a Rare weapon or quiver / armour or belt / amulet or ring, item level 64 or lower.

V1_BLOODMARK.rule: Bloodvial of Komaki / Eldra / Rithva: a Bloodmark in place of a chosen suffix, same three groups, Minimum Modifier Level 65.

V1_REFORGE.rule: Reforging turns every marked modifier into a new random one, fractured at once.

V1_NO_REMARK.rule: A fractured item cannot be marked again.

V1_TWO_FRACTURED.rule: An item can have up to two fractured modifiers.

V1_FORGE_SIDE.rule: A Forgemark's new modifier is of the marked one's side.

V1_BLOOD_GROUPS.rule: Which modifiers the Komaki, Eldra and Rithva groups hold (the engine draws from every suffix of level 65+).

V1_MIX.rule: Forgemarks and Bloodmarks can be on one item and reforged together.

V1_FRACTURE_ORB.rule: The Fracturing Orb still needs four modifiers and works next to Forgemarks.

V1_EXISTING.rule: Existing currencies, omens, essences, bones, runes, affix limits and the crafted-modifier limit are unchanged in 1.0.

V1_FORGE_POOL.rule: A Forgemark's new modifier rolls from the item's own pool at its item level (64 or lower) with the usual weights.

V1_BENCH.rule: Marking and reforging is one step: nothing is used on the item in between, and the Reforging Bench costs nothing besides the marking items.

V1_SWORDS.rule: Swords and daggers are real item classes (the KB marks swords unconfirmed_class).
